name: tournyx-esports-app
description: Tournyx Esports Cross-Platform App (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run prep:www && npx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run prep:www && npx tauri build
